item.title: Iron Maiden Documentary "Burning Ambition" Trailer Teases a Deep Dive Into 50 Years of Metal History
item.description: Iron Maiden has released the first trailer for Burning Ambition, a new documentary tracing the band’s 50-year history. The film arrives in theaters on May 7, 2026.

item.title: Bassist Ana Pshokina Leads a Hard-Grooving Jazz Fusion Quintet in Lisbon
item.description: This Lisbon session features bassist Ana Pshokina on a custom Sandberg 5, driving a tight jazz fusion quintet with dynamic interplay and electric sax textures.

item.title: Josh Paul Powers New Supergroup The Masses on Two Explosive Debut Singles
item.description: The Masses, a new Nashville supergroup featuring Josh Paul on bass, have released their first two singles: “Drug Lord” and a cover of Beastie Boys’ “Intergalactic.”

item.title: Tedeschi Trucks Band Return with "Future Soul," A Genre-Blending New Chapter
item.description: Tedeschi Trucks Band return with "Future Soul," a genre-blending new album featuring bassist Brandon Boone. Watch live video and see 2026 tour dates.

item.title: Chicago’s 1970 Tanglewood Performance Shows Peter Cetera at Full Power
item.description: This 1970 performance captures Chicago at peak intensity, as Peter Cetera’s aggressive, melodic bass powers “25 or 6 to 4” from the inside out.

item.title: First Look: Fender Unveils 75th Anniversary Precision Bass Collection
item.description: Fender celebrates 75 years of the Precision Bass with three limited edition models, including the American Vintage II 1951 Precision, Player II Precision, and American Professional PJ Bass.

item.title: MonoNeon Releases Joyful Live Version of “Better Days Are Coming”
item.description: MonoNeon has released “Better Days Are Coming (Live),” a vibrant new recording from Sofia, Bulgaria featuring his band and an electrifying bass solo.

item.title: Bass Meets Beats: 95MP’s Drum and Bass Duo Leans Into a Fusion Trip-Hop Sound
item.description: Bass and drums go far beyond the basics as 95MP blends jazz fusion, trip-hop, and layered textures in a three-tune live set.

item.title: Weekly Top 10: Auction Shockers, Steve Bailey to Step Down, and More
item.description: This week’s top bass stories include Christie’s Jim Irsay Collection auction results, Steve Bailey stepping down from Berklee, the Markbass GV 5 GOG, and more.

item.title: Bartolini MG4PJ Bass Pickup Packs P/J Design into Music Man-Style Housing
item.description: Bartolini has introduced the MG4PJ bass pickup, a new quad-coil model that fits a P/J configuration into a Music Man-style cover for punchy, clear tone.

item.title: Michael Manring Redefines the Bass in “Enormous Room” Live in Chicago
item.description: Michael Manring closed out a packed Solo Bass Day in Chicago, reshaping the bass with real-time retuning, resonance, and orchestral depth.

item.title: Roger Hedin’s Custom Unicornbass Pure Art S2 Fretless Features 3,000-Year-Old Redwood and No Controls
item.description: Roger Hedin teamed up with luthier Christian Olsson to create a custom Unicornbass Pure Art S2 fretless, featuring 3,000-year-old redwood and a minimalist no-controls design.

item.title: The Doobie Brothers Add Fall 2026 “Walk This Road” Tour Dates as "Takin’ It to the Streets" Turns 50
item.description: The Doobie Brothers have announced a fall 2026 leg of their “Walk This Road” tour, coinciding with the 50th anniversary of "Takin’ It to the Streets".
